subject.title: fix: setup fails closed for invalid configuration arguments

question: Should SetupEngine reject duplicate values for every value-taking option, or preserve first-value-wins behavior outside the explicit configuration safety boundary?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes the contract for all nine value options. This is a compatibility choice for existing scripts, not a purely mechanical parser correction.

options.title: Adopt global duplicate rejection
options.body: Keep exit code 2 for duplicate values on every SetupEngine value option and treat the documented contract as the supported automation behavior.

options.title: Narrow duplicate rejection
options.body: Reject duplicates only where ambiguity can trigger unsafe setup behavior, while preserving legacy behavior for unrelated options.

recommendation.title: Adopt global duplicate rejection
recommendation.body: Keep exit code 2 for duplicate values on every SetupEngine value option and treat the documented contract as the supported automation behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They implemented and documented the proposed all-options policy; a setup-area owner should confirm the final compatibility contract.
